question: Which author won the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar for his novel, ‘Ram C/O Anandhi’, in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akhil P Dharmajan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sahitya Akademi** announced the **Yuva Puraskar** for **2024** (and recognized in cycles extending into **2025**) to honor young writers across various Indian languages.
 
• **Akhil P Dharmajan** was conferred with the **Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar** for his exceptionally popular novel, **‘Ram C/O Anandhi’**.
 
• He is a noted author in the **Malayalam** language, and his winning work **‘Ram C/O Anandhi’** has been a major bestseller, noted for its engaging storytelling and relatable themes for the youth.
 
• The award was announced in **June** as part of the annual literary honors provided by the **Sahitya Akademi**, India's National Academy of Letters.
